import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final int N = 50 * T + 2;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f;

    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
        Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v;
            this.r = r;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
            this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        static ArrayList<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[N];
        static int[] sz = new int[N];
        static long mc;
        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
        static int[] par = new int[N];
        static long[] pot = new long[N], dist = new long[N];

        static {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        static void init() {
            mc = 0;
            Arrays.fill(sz, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        static void pot_init(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0, n, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c != 0) {
                            pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            long flow = 0;
            long lb = 1L << 30;
            while (lb > 0) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    vis[i] = false;
                }
                if (sparse) {
                    PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                    pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                    while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                        long[] u = pq.poll();
                        int uIdx = (int) u[1];
                        if (vis[uIdx]) continue;
                        vis[uIdx] = true;
                        for (Edge e : adj[uIdx]) {
                            if (e.f <= e.c - lb && dist[e.v] > dist[uIdx] + pot[uIdx] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                                dist[e.v] = dist[uIdx] + pot[uIdx] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                                par[e.v] = e.r;
                                pq.offer(new long[]{-dist[e.v], e.v});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int u = 0; u != -1; ) {
                        vis[u] = true;
                        for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                            if (e.f <= e.c - lb && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                                dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                                par[e.v] = e.r;
                            }
                        }
                        u = -1;
                        long best = INF;
                        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                                best = dist[i];
                                u = i;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] >= INF) {
                    return 0;
                }
                long df = INF;
                for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v].get(par[adj[u].get(par[u]).v]).v) {
                    Edge r = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v];
                    Edge e = r;
                    df = Math.min(df, adj[r.v].get(r.r).c - adj[r.v].get(r.r).f);
                }
                for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v].get(par[adj[u].get(par[u]).v]).v) {
                    Edge r = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v];
                    Edge e = r;
                    e.f += df;
                    adj[r.v].get(r.r).f -= df;
                    price[0] += df * e.p;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
                }
            }
            return 0; // placeholder, actual flow is sum of augmenting flows
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        Flow.init();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] edges = new int[m][2];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            edges[i][0] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            edges[i][1] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        for (int[] edge : edges) {
            int a = edge[0];
            int b = edge[1];
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int costVal = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, costVal * d + c);
                    Flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, costVal * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = Flow.min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
